ctx.x: been aided and helped by Mr. James Collier whom I think is a very, very fine person. Very capable reporter. And a musician in addition. He has all of the qualities that I think a person should have, and I'm very very grateful, again, I keep on repeating it.
I also thank three persons. Will Marion Cook, Eugene Mikell, and Edmund Jenkins for all that they've done for me. And I would like to say, 'God Bless You All'.
